boundary: One phase worker, followed by host-owned completion; no whole-project/group completion claim
foreignCase: Expected success is preserved foreign ownership plus an evidence-backed blocker, never fabricated completion; functional completion is not expected
workerAuthority: Worker must not call complete/close/audit-receipt/review-receipt/verdict or manually edit its ticket; host-owned journal/complete writes are separate
trajectory: Complete capture does not prove every action justified; opaque Bash remains unknown, unrelated or terminal-authority actions are not silently accepted
quality: Judge is an independent bounded diagnosis, not completion authority. Host facts and canonical CLI proof remain separate. A judge PASS alone cannot qualify a run
comparability: Report every reserved/dispatched position. Do not call a censored, budget-limited, failed, or incomplete run a cost/time saving. Percent comparisons only within comparable completed qualified pairs
usage: Primary tokens/tools/time exclude setup, host validation, independent judge and same-worker reflection; those overheads are reported separately. Token total excludes cacheRead. Provider cost zero is not free
sample: One sample per case/arm; descriptive results, no statistical non-inferiority or universal speed claim
privacy: No private repository source, command arguments, file paths, free-text judgments or reflections in public artifacts; retain private compact evidence outside Git and publish hashes/numbers/enums only
termination: Eight model-dispatched primary positions maximum, no replacement or automatic new experiment series. The zero-dispatch initialization reservation is preserved in the predecessor records
